name: Fast code tutorial (Fireship-style)
description: Dense, short coding explainer: dead air cut tight, the problem typed out on screen, one key takeaway callout and an end card. A music bed (when you supply music) is added. Code zooms, memes and sound effects are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

variables.name: title
variables.label: The problem, in one line
variables.example: Your build is slow. Here is why.

beats.name: Name the problem
beats.guidance: State the problem in the first seconds.

beats.name: The idea
beats.guidance: Explain the concept in plain words.

beats.name: Code
beats.guidance: Show the code large enough to read on a phone; every shot must teach, entertain or set up the next.

deferred.title: Code zooms
deferred.description: Zoom into the lines being discussed. The zoom itself exists (add_zoom with a focus point), but the editor cannot tell which lines are being discussed.

deferred.title: Meme and image inserts
deferred.description: Short image or meme cutaways for jokes.

deferred.title: Sound effects
deferred.description: Short effects on transitions and jokes.

notes.text: Footage, images, memes, logos and music from other people need permission or a licence that covers your use. Fair use depends on the country and is not automatic.

Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Check the licence of any code you show, and remove secrets, tokens and personal data from the screen.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
